title: "Only when..." exceptions
idea: Most of these are banned, with one narrow exception each. Learn the exception and the rest follows.

items: Only when incidental to retransmitting manned spacecraft communications
Only control commands to space stations or model craft
Only when sending signals to control model craft
Allowed for classroom instruction at a school
Amateur equipment, not on a regular basis
Only for immediate safety of life or property, with no other means
Only for immediate safety of life or property
Broadcasting is prohibited. Code practice, event announcements and telemetry are fine

cards.t: Music, incidental to retransmitting manned spacecraft communications
cards.why: That's the one case music is allowed.

cards.t: Music, kept under three minutes an hour
cards.why: There's no time allowance. Music is only for retransmitting manned spacecraft.

cards.t: Coded commands to control a space station
cards.why: Control commands to space stations or model craft may be encoded.

cards.t: Approved digital codes used to hide a message's meaning
cards.why: Obscuring meaning is only for control commands to space stations or model craft.
Code practice is an allowed one-way transmission.

cards.t: Mentioning your ham gear for sale, now and then
cards.why: Amateur equipment, not on a regular basis, is fine.

cards.t: Getting paid to operate as part of classroom instruction
cards.why: Compensation is allowed for classroom instruction at a school.

cards.t: Getting paid to gather emergency info for a broadcast station
cards.why: Classroom instruction is the compensation exception, not this.

cards.t: Helping news gathering when life is in immediate danger and there's no other way
cards.why: Allowed when directly related to the immediate safety of life or property.

cards.t: Skipping your ID during brief station adjustments
cards.why: Only model craft control signals skip ID.

cards.t: Skipping your ID while controlling a model craft
cards.why: Model craft control signals don't need ID.

cards.t: Going outside your privileges to protect someone's life
cards.why: Allowed only for the immediate safety of life or property.

cards.t: Going outside your privileges as part of a RACES plan
cards.why: A plan doesn't do it. Only an immediate threat to life or property.

traps.why: Code practice is allowed. Broadcasting is what's prohibited.

traps.wrong: Only when transmitting certain approved digital codes
traps.why: Encoding to hide meaning is only for control commands to space stations or model craft.

traps.wrong: When transmissions are limited to less than three minutes per hour
traps.why: No time limit makes music OK. Only when incidental to retransmitting manned spacecraft.
You may mention amateur equipment for sale or trade, as long as it's not on a regular basis.

traps.wrong: When the communication is made to obtain emergency information for a local broadcast station
traps.why: The paid exception is classroom instruction.

traps.wrong: When the transmissions are of a brief nature to make station adjustments
traps.why: Brief adjustments still need ID. Only model craft control signals don't.

traps.wrong: Yes, but only when part of a RACES emergency plan
traps.why: Only immediate safety of life or protection of property allows it.
